name: ECCE (Early Childhood Care and Education)
benefit: - Providing infrastructure facilities such as furniture, TLM, and child-friendly furniture in co-located Anganwadi centres functioning within the premises of government schools in the state. - Training of Anganwadi workers and assistants. - Ensuring pre-school readiness so that children acquire cognitive and psychological skills before admission to Class 1.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant should be a boy or girl aged between 3 to 6 years. 1. The child (boy/girl) must not have completed 6 years of age as on the date of commencement of the academic session.
